Hi Elena — thanks for sending these over. Quick notes after a first pass: 

- Certificate lists Redwood as "Certificate Holder" but we require an endorsement that names Redwood Inference as an "Additional Insured" on the General Liability policy with 30-day notice of cancellation wording.
- Policy limits look fine (1M/2M), but the policy effective/expiry dates need to cover the full expected contract term (through 2027-12-31) — can you confirm?
- We also need a waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood where applicable.

If you can get the endorsement, please attach as a separate PDF. If the endorsement will take a few days, we can provisionally issue a conditional PO but need finance to sign off on staging — looping Ben and Marcus.

Action items: 
- Elena: confirm endorsement timing and updated COI with additional insured language
- Marcus/Ben: confirm whether Procurement/Finance can create a conditional PO (net 30) pending endorsement receipt

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
